Think your brain is fast? 🧠⚡
Try this simple falling-note reaction test and see how quickly you can catch it!

When you drop the note yourself, your brain already knows what's about to happen. But when someone else drops it, your brain has to see → process → react.

That tiny delay is your reaction time. ⏱️

Try it with your friends and compare who has the fastest reaction! 👀
